projection.parameterization: Bevy 0.19 default PerspectiveProjection; exact implementation is bound by the renderer source commit

capture_time_bounds.upper_bound_semantics: capture plugin exit timeout upper bound; successful receipts imply each image was flushed before this bound

calibration.claim: no physical camera calibration or metric accuracy is implied

claim_ceiling: static synthetic sensor profile and capture schedule only; camera trajectory/pose remains evaluator-only; no physical camera calibration or metric accuracy implied

pose_delivery.candidate_input: RGB frames and static camera/sensor profile only
pose_delivery.rationale: V1 isolates image-only delayed topology identification; a pose-provided arm requires a separate, explicitly budgeted protocol
